subject.why: The retro canister vacuum cleaner is fully identifiable with its hose and rocket fins.

category.why: The background has vertical wall panelling rather than a simple smooth gradient wall.

clean.why: No text, UI, watermarks, or characters are present.

framing.why: The composition is well-centered with sufficient border margins.

colour.why: High-contrast, vibrant palette separates the blue vacuum clearly from the background.

detail.why: Shapes remain bold and chunky without noisy surface textures.

style.why: Smooth, satin-rendered 3D volumes align well with the reference art style.

fix: Replace the slatted wood wall panelling with a clean, smooth gradient background.
